email.subject: Summit Co's site on mobile
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I checked Summit Co Heating & Cooling's website. Two things are likely costing you calls: it isn't set up for mobile, so most people searching "HVAC near me" on their phone see a broken layout and probably just call the next result. And there are no customer reviews showing, which matters a lot when someone's picking a heating/cooling company for the first time.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer.

Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd fix first? No pressure either way.

Alex
